# Seconds per package, used by ci-rshard-packages.sh to balance the default (r0..r3) test shards.
# Source: the per-package times `go test` printed in CI run 42179351326, shards r0..r3 (hosted
# runners), CALIBRATED TO WALL TIME: each package's printed elapsed time (taken under load, many
# packages in parallel on one runner) is multiplied by (the shard's Test wall seconds / the sum of
# its packages' printed times): r0 732/6581, r1 1308/5661, r2 1332/6051, r3 1596/8996. The raw
# elapsed times were not comparable between shards (that ratio ran from 4.3x to 9x), which left
# the shards 13-27 min apart. Whole seconds, minimum 1, every package that run listed. A package
# missing from this file (new) weighs 5. Refresh occasionally: nothing breaks if it goes stale,
# the split just drifts.
